pages.title: Princess Peach and Daisy Dressed as Mario and Luigi Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Princess Peach dressed as Mario and Princess Daisy as Luigi, posing together in their signature lettered caps, short overalls, and gloves.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Using Flower Power in a Blooming Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy uses flower power in a blooming garden in this printable coloring page, opening both hands as blossoms and loose petals swirl around her waist. Floral details repeat on her crown, earrings, gown, and shoes, while tulips, daisies, climbing stems, and a small garden arch frame the scene.

pages.title: Baby Daisy Playing with a Toy Crown on a Nursery Rug Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Daisy plays with a toy crown on a nursery rug in this printable coloring page, sitting with her feet stretched forward and a pacifier in her mouth. Large stars decorate the pointed crown between her hands, while simple floorboards and the rug's wavy edge surround her rounded figure.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Shooting a Basketball on a Mario Sports Court Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy shoots a basketball on a Mario Sports court in this printable coloring page, lifting one arm toward the ball beside a tall hoop and net. A mushroom emblem decorates the backboard, while Daisy's crown, flower earrings, short sports skirt, and sneakers add smaller details above the court markings.

pages.title: Paper Princess Daisy Holding a Folding Fan in a Flower Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Paper Princess Daisy holds a folding fan in a flower garden in this printable coloring page, smiling above the open fan with both gloved hands together. Small blossoms and leaves decorate its pleated panels, while tulips, daisies, low bushes, and a castle tower surround her flower-patterned gown.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Reading a Map in a Sarasaland Palace Hall Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy reads a map in a Sarasaland palace hall in this printable coloring page, holding the broad folded sheet in front of her layered gown. A dotted route and small compass mark the map, while tall columns and repeated rounded arches form a symmetrical backdrop behind her crown.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Crossing a Rope Bridge in a Mario Party Minigame Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy crosses a rope bridge in a Mario Party minigame in this printable coloring page, extending both hands as she steps along the suspended wooden planks. Thick knots and vertical rope supports repeat beside her layered skirt, with a steep cliff, rocks, bushes, and a small tree beyond the crossing.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Swinging a Golf Club on a Mario Golf Course Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy swings a golf club on a Mario Golf course in this printable coloring page, finishing the motion with both hands high beside her crown. A small ball travels over the rolling fairway, while palm trees, a flagged hole, sand bunkers, flowers, and a spotted mushroom detail the course.

pages.title: Cute Princess Daisy Smiling Beside Blooming Daisies in a Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute Princess Daisy smiles beside blooming daisies in a meadow in this printable coloring page, resting her hands together beneath her flower-shaped earrings and floral headband. Large petals repeat across the surrounding field and her dress, with curved hills, grass blades, and fluffy clouds behind the cheerful portrait.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Racing on Rainbow Road in Mario Kart Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy races along Rainbow Road in this Mario Kart printable coloring page, gripping the steering wheel of a flower-decorated kart beneath her small pointed crown. Her name appears on the side panel, with treaded tires, a rear wing, guardrails, clouds, a star, and a crescent moon around the curving track.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Drifting a Kart Around a Mario Kart Corner Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy drifts a kart around a Mario Kart corner in this printable coloring page, steering with one hand while raising her other glove beside her face. Smoke curls from the rear tires as sweeping lines trace the bend, with exposed engine parts and a broad wing behind her seat.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Jumping Over a Talking Flower in the Flower Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy jumps over a Talking Flower in the Flower Kingdom in this printable coloring page, raising both hands as her short skirt lifts above bent knees. The smiling flower has an empty speech bubble beside its petals, with small mushrooms, blossoms, and flower-patterned hills behind Daisy's crown and sneakers.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Making a Peace Sign on a Garden Path Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy makes a peace sign on a garden path in this printable coloring page, smiling with two fingers raised beside her puffed sleeve and flower earrings. Floral bushes line the winding paved route behind her, while scalloped gown layers, a flower brooch, crown, and grass tufts provide smaller details.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Gliding with a Parachute Above a Mario Kart Track Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy glides with a parachute above a Mario Kart track in this printable coloring page, holding the suspension lines on either side of her crowned head. A broad segmented canopy fills the upper scene, while mushrooms, Warp Pipes, clouds, and sweeping road curves surround her long layered dress.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Dancing in Her Dress in a Castle Ballroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy dances in her dress inside a castle ballroom in this printable coloring page, extending both arms as her flower-trimmed skirt swings widely around her legs. Swirling floor patterns echo the movement beneath a tall arched window, wall candles, floral arrangements, and a hanging castle banner.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Throwing a Party Dice Block in a Mario Party Board Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy throws a party Dice Block on a Mario Party board in this printable coloring page, reaching upward toward the large star-marked cube above her glove. Stars, coins, and Bowser symbols fill the winding board spaces, with a Question Block sign, Warp Pipe, mushroom, and castle along the route.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Holding a Tennis Trophy Beside the Net Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy holds a tennis trophy beside the net in this printable coloring page, smiling with both hands around the tall cup beneath her flower-decorated headband. A tennis ball tops the trophy between curled handles, while her ponytail, pleated sports skirt, sneakers, and court lines complete the scene.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Holding a Daisy Flower in a Palace Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy holds a daisy flower in a palace garden in this printable coloring page, resting one hand at her waist while presenting the tall stem beside her face. Roses and daisies border the path, with a stone arch, rounded trees, and flag-topped palace towers beyond her broad skirt.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Batting a Baseball in a Mario Sports Stadium Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy bats a baseball in a Mario Sports stadium in this printable coloring page, gripping the bat with both gloves as she turns across the marked field. Stitching details the outlined baseballs near the swing, while mushroom emblems, packed stands, a large arch, and distant pipes frame her sports uniform.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Descending a Castle Staircase in Her Gown Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy descends a castle staircase in her gown in this printable coloring page, lifting the side of her flower-trimmed skirt as one shoe reaches the next step. Curled railing patterns follow the broad spiral stairway, with block walls and a pointed window showing clouds and hills beside her.

pages.title: Easy Princess Daisy Sitting Beside a Large Daisy in Sarasaland Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy sits beside a large daisy in Sarasaland in this easy printable coloring page, resting both gloved hands together on the folds of her long skirt. The oversized flower rises above her crown on a simple stem, with broad petals, low hills, grass tufts, pebbles, and a small sun nearby.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Putting a Golf Ball on a Mario Golf Green Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy putts a golf ball on a Mario Golf green in this printable coloring page, bending over the club with both hands beneath her flower crown. A flag marked 7 stands beside the hole near her shoes, while grass tufts, rolling fairway lines, trees, and a cloud frame the scene.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Collecting Coins on a Mushroom Kingdom Path Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy collects coins on a Mushroom Kingdom path in this printable coloring page, reaching toward a star-marked coin as she steps along uneven stone paving. Two more coins float behind her flower-trimmed gown, with mushrooms, rounded hills, Question Blocks, and Piranha Plants lining the route.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Holding a Super Mushroom on a Mushroom Kingdom Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy holds a Super Mushroom on a Mushroom Kingdom hill in this printable coloring page, smiling as both gloves support the large spotted cap and oval-eyed stem. Her crown and layered gown stand against flowered bushes, rounded hills, grass tufts, and two broad cloud shapes.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Holding a Super Star Beside a Warp Pipe Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy holds a Super Star beside a Warp Pipe in this printable coloring page, wearing a flower headband and smiling above the five-pointed star between her hands. The pipe's wide rim rises beside her gown, with paired leaves at its base and simple clouds behind the full-length figure.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Blocking a Soccer Ball as Goalkeeper in a Mario Strikers Stadium Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy blocks a soccer ball as goalkeeper in a Mario Strikers stadium in this printable coloring page, diving sideways with both hands stretched toward the ball. The gridded goal net fills the background behind her crown and sports kit, with cheering Toads and tall floodlights above the stands.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Smiling Outside Sarasaland Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy smiles outside Sarasaland Castle in this printable coloring page, clasping her gloves near her flower brooch beneath a crown edged with large rounded blossoms. Twin pointed towers fly flower-emblem flags behind her, while battlements, arched windows, bushes, and a pebble-lined path complete the palace approach.

pages.title: Baby Daisy Driving a Small Kart on a Mario Kart Track Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Daisy drives a small kart on a Mario Kart track in this printable coloring page, waving one hand while keeping the other on the steering wheel. A flower emblem marks the kart's nose, with broad tires, an exhaust pipe, stars, a mushroom, and an overhead banner along the curving road.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Holding a Mario Kart Trophy on a Winners Podium Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy holds a Mario Kart trophy on a winners' podium in this printable coloring page, raising the handled cup as she curls her opposite glove into a fist. Steering-wheel emblems decorate the trophy above the first-place block, while a checkered sign marks the distant track arch behind her flowered boots.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Throwing a Dodgeball in a Mario Sports Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy throws a dodgeball in a Mario Sports arena in this printable coloring page, drawing the ball behind one shoulder while extending her other hand forward. Her high ponytail and short sports outfit follow the twisting pose, with court lines, spectators, a mushroom banner, and an arch in the background.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Riding a Motorbike on a Mario Kart Speedway Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy rides a motorbike on a Mario Kart speedway in this printable coloring page, gripping the handlebars above a front plate marked 06 and a broad tire. Engine fins, a curved exhaust, and her tall riding boots add detail, while the winding track leads toward a distant flag-topped castle.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Wearing a Crown in a Royal Portrait Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy wears a crown in a royal portrait room in this printable coloring page, clasping her gloves above a gown decorated with flowers and layered necklaces. An oval portrait hangs on floral wallpaper behind her, with a candle stand, ornate table, wall panels, tiled floor, and tied curtains nearby.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Running Across a Wonder Flower Platform Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy runs across a Wonder Flower platform in this printable coloring page, pumping her fists as she takes a long stride in shorts and sports shoes. Flower shapes and a small oval-eyed emblem decorate the raised platform, while Talking Flowers, low hills, drifting leaves, and clouds frame the route.

pages.title: Chibi Princess Daisy Winking Beside a Super Mushroom in a Castle Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Princess Daisy winks beside a Super Mushroom in a castle garden in this printable coloring page, raising one open glove while resting the other on its spotted cap. Her flower crown and layered dress match the rounded figure, with flag-topped towers, paving stones, small flowers, and grass around her.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Exploring the Flower Kingdom in Super Mario Bros Wonder Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy explores the Flower Kingdom in this Super Mario Bros. Wonder printable coloring page, walking along a winding path with a small Talking Flower in one hand. More oval-eyed flowers rise among bushes behind her, while loose petals, curled stems, low hills, and a tulip surround her short dress.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Riding a Horse on a Mario Sports Track Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy rides a horse on a Mario Sports track in this printable coloring page, holding the reins above the saddle as the horse lifts its front legs. The bridle, mane, tail, and stirrups add equestrian details, with palms, rounded hills, a mushroom marker, and a distant castle along the track.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Running From a Goomba on a Brick Path Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy runs from a Goomba on a brick path in this printable coloring page, glancing backward with a surprised expression as her skirt and hair sweep behind her. The small fanged Goomba follows close to her raised heel, with grass tufts, clouds, and rectangular paving stones completing the route.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Waving in a Flower Garden in Sarasaland Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy waves in a flower garden in Sarasaland in this printable coloring page, raising one glove beside the blossoms in her hair and small pointed crown. A Piranha Plant grows from an ornamental pot nearby, while tulips, daisies, low hills, and a distant stone arch surround her patterned gown.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Driving a Kart on a Mario Kart Racetrack Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy drives a kart on a Mario Kart racetrack in this printable coloring page, smiling as she holds the wheel above a large flower emblem on the nose. Motion lines follow the tires along the bend, with a rear engine, striped curbs, rounded trees, and a tall M-marked arch behind her.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Cheering in a Victory Pose on a Castle Terrace Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy cheers in a victory pose on a castle terrace in this printable coloring page, raising both fists and bending one leg behind her layered skirt. A tall open stone arch reveals a flag-topped tower beyond the battlements, while broad paving stones and small clouds frame her lifted arms.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Boxing with Gloves in a Sports Gym Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy boxes with gloves in a sports gym in this printable coloring page, holding both padded fists near her smiling face beneath her small pointed crown. Ring ropes stretch behind her shoulders, while a hanging punching bag and rectangular wall window add simple training-room details to the close portrait.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Giving a Thumbs Up in a Sports Stadium Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy gives a thumbs-up in a sports stadium in this printable coloring page, resting her other glove on her hip above shorts and knee-high socks. A flower emblem decorates her jersey beneath her crown, while cheering spectators, curved stands, a floodlight, and part of a goal frame the field.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Hitting a Question Block on a Grassy Mario Platform Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy hits a Question Block on a grassy Mario platform in this printable coloring page, jumping with one fist raised toward the large outlined question mark. Small stars and impact lines radiate around the block, with nearby bricks, a Warp Pipe, rounded hills, and a bird perched on a smiling cloud.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Holding an Umbrella in a Royal Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy holds an umbrella in a royal garden in this printable coloring page, resting its curved handle near her shoulder beneath a wide flower-patterned canopy. Scalloped trim edges the umbrella above her crown, while a vine-wrapped ornamental arch, daisies, tulips, bushes, and clouds surround her broad gown.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Sitting on a Throne in Sarasaland Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy sits on a throne in Sarasaland Castle in this printable coloring page, resting her hands across her lap beneath a tall arched floral chair back. Curling stems and daisies decorate the throne's frame, with a sun emblem, small castle window, tied curtains, columns, and floor tiles around her.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Jumping Beside a Warp Pipe in the Mushroom Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy jumps beside a Warp Pipe in the Mushroom Kingdom in this printable coloring page, lifting both fists as her layered skirt spreads above her pointed shoes. Smiling clouds float over rounded hills behind her, with a small coin block at the pipe's base and scattered grass along the platform.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Returning a Tennis Ball with a Backhand on a Mario Tennis Court Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy returns a tennis ball with a backhand on a Mario Tennis court in this printable coloring page, holding the raised racket across her body with both hands. Her ponytail curves behind her crown, while racket strings, skirt folds, sneakers, court markings, and part of the net add sports details.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Serving a Tennis Ball on a Mario Tennis Court Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy serves a tennis ball on a Mario Tennis court in this printable coloring page, tossing it above her open glove while lifting the racket behind her head. The net and rectangular court lines recede behind her sneakers, with a flower brooch, small crown, and short sports skirt clearly outlined.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Watering Flowers with a Watering Can in a Palace Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy waters flowers with a watering can in a palace garden in this printable coloring page, tilting the decorated can over a raised bed of blossoms. Drops fall toward daisies and tulips beneath her gloves, while an ornamental arch, stone paving, wall flowers, and grass frame her layered gown.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Kicking a Soccer Ball in a Mario Strikers Stadium Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy kicks a soccer ball in a Mario Strikers stadium in this printable coloring page, extending one cleated shoe toward the large patterned ball beside her. Her ponytail trails behind the running pose, with tall socks, a flower-emblem jersey, chain-link fencing, and an arched entrance surrounding the field.

pages.title: Princess Daisy Holding an Elephant Fruit in the Flower Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy holds an Elephant Fruit in the Flower Kingdom in this printable coloring page, presenting the large textured fruit with both gloves above her flower-trimmed gown. A small leaf curves from its stem, while tall daisies, tulips, low bushes, rolling hills, and a tiny castle complete the garden landscape.

pages.title: Mario Princess Daisy in Amusement Park Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy waves at an amusement park in this printable coloring page, raising one open glove beside her crown as her other hand stretches above a broad skirt. A Ferris wheel fills one side of the background, with a looping roller coaster, pointed castle towers, clouds, and curved paths behind her.

pages.title: Mario Princess Daisy in Frozen Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy visits a frozen valley in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath her flower crown with a long scarf wrapped around her neck and trailing behind her. Large snowflakes hang above the close portrait, while snowcapped peaks, bare trees, rounded snowy canopies, and a winding route frame her gown.

pages.title: Mario Princess Daisy in Lava Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy appears inside a lava castle in this printable coloring page, facing forward through a low rounded stone opening beneath a tall arch of large blocks. A small Bowser emblem decorates the wall beside her, while bubbling lava patterns curl around the foreground below her flower brooch and puffed sleeves.

pages.title: Mario Princess Daisy in Volcanic Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy stands in a volcanic valley in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath her crown against a landscape of steep cliffs and narrow winding lava channels. Smoke rises from a distant volcano beside smaller pointed peaks, while sparse plants, cracked rock ledges, clouds, and a partly hidden sun surround the portrait.

pages.title: Mario Princess Daisy in Peach's Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Daisy visits Peach's castle in this printable coloring page, standing beneath a broad rounded arch with her gloved hands lowered beside the folds of her gown. A tall flower-patterned window sits between the columns behind her, with flag-topped towers, tiled flooring, and a gem-centered crown adding architectural and costume details.
